title: Modular A/V: Strongbox theme
description: A rogue's locked box for the Modular A/V dock. The dock is the front of a strongbox of dark oiled boards in an iron band, a padlock at its top. Each camera is a window strapped in iron with a lock over it, three kinds in turn. A voice lights the lamp inside, amber through the keyhole; muted, an iron shutter slides down and a padlock hangs on the hasp; deafened, a rag fills the keyhole; out of the call, the lock is forced. Picks, keys and rope hang where there is room.

facts.label: Who picks it
facts.value: The GM, as the table's look, or each player
